I thought you said it was empty. Can you hear that?
scope: Offline paired preview experiment. Three alternatives per text and seed. Repeats assess stability; ordinary preparation keeps its existing preview budget. The labeled cases are character-level listening reports, not rankings for each seed. All fresh characters are held out from those listening reports.
selection: For each fresh character, exclude the largest bank other than that of the nearest four-second, highest-quality routed catalog clip (bank-name tie break). Apply the frozen steady/typical selector with this bank withheld. Orientation original is the highest passing quality clip nearest four seconds in the withheld bank; SHA-256 breaks ties.

signal_rules.qa: Existing generated-speech silence gate, analysis version 2
signal_rules.asr: Normalized exact text match; mismatch is advisory, not proven synthesis error
signal_rules.pitch_span: Existing Praat 10th-90th percentile span; 1 semitone descriptive tie margin
signal_rules.terminal_pitch: Median pitch of final voiced 300ms minus preceding voiced 300ms; contour only, not question classification
signal_rules.direction: Every matched text/seed retained; opposite directions yield mixed
signal_rules.interpretation: No signal establishes listener preference or neutral/questioning appropriateness; no automated ranking

additional_signal.name: DNSMOS P.835, non-personalized, SIG
additional_signal.measurement: Verified PCM, downmix, soxr 16 kHz, double short waveforms to fill 9.01 s segments, 1 s hops, SIG polynomial per segment then average. Higher is predicted speech quality. Report matched score directions including seed/text reversals; descriptive differences have no acceptance threshold.

source_text_check.catalog_excerpt: I can't go with you. Someone has to stay behind to speak for the others.
source_text_check.scope: The listener flagged the mismatch. The verified source WAV independently yielded a materially shorter automatic transcript. The game event links the clip to the written story line; the catalog admitted the clip using audio-only evidence.

listening_feedback.confidence: Repeat listening supersedes the initial tentative A preference. The listener found Steady slow but closer to the original voice.
listening_feedback.source_feedback: The listener reported that the original B recording differed from its displayed text.

full_pool_followup.question: What selected the previous references, and what would the same selector pick with the validation bank restored?

source_inventory.scope: Installed English audio banks associated with hero3145 and skin hero314503. Bank membership also covers other speaker labels, including singing. Unique encoded WEMs and unique decoded WAVs are measured at different stages.

previous_comparison.typical: Among clips tied for the top technical score, the highest mean speaker-embedding similarity to the other fit originals.
previous_comparison.steady: Start with technically top-scoring clips with measurable delivery. Require top-quartile speaker similarity, character-central pitch and relatively moderate pitch and loudness variation. Two passed these gates. The question “Do you want an audience so badly?” was excluded by written punctuation.

typical_and_steady_choice.text: It is so quiet I can hear the streets, the houses, and even the paving stones beneath my feet.

full_pool.source_whisper: It is so quiet, I can hear the streets, the houses, and even the paving stones beneath my feet.
full_pool.validation: Same catalog, encoder and selection settings with no held-out bank. This source was unavailable to the two previous methods. Source previously used for independent measurement is now part of selection, so that earlier bank can no longer serve as an independent evaluation for this trial.

generation_comparison.control: Previously preferred Steady WAVs from the fresh Everecho trial. Reused unchanged.

generation_comparison.listening_feedback: The listener preferred the new full-pool reference over the previous Steady reference for Everecho.

listening_feedback.reason: A sounded too slow, particularly on line 1 at seed 0. On line 2 at seed 1, B had unusual pauses that the listener found artistic and acceptable.

listening_feedback.preference: All three sounded good. The listener heard no noticeable difference between seeds.

fallback_only_control.reason: No distinct steady recording qualified. Its typical vs current comparison was retained as a fallback example and excluded from paired steady/typical statistics.

interpretation: Steady was preferred for Hedone and, on repeat listening, Everecho. All three methods were acceptable for Cornerstone. The listener valued Everecho’s closer voice despite slower pacing and a source-caption mismatch. Pitch differences, pause flags and caption discrepancies do not independently establish an audible defect.
